g=[[6]*29 for _ in range(8)]
for c in list(range(1,13))+list(range(14,20))+list(range(23,28)): g[2][c]=9
for r in [3,4,6]: g[r][1]=g[r][27]=9
for c in list(range(1,7))+list(range(8,11))+[12,14]+list(range(16,21))+[22,23,26,27]: g[5][c]=9
for c in [1]+list(range(3,12))+[15,16]+list(range(18,23))+list(range(24,28)): g[7][c]=9
from collections import Counter
counts=Counter(c for r in range(8) for c in range(29) if g[r][c]==9)
cols=[c for c,n in counts.items() if n>=3]
for c in range(1,28):
    if g[2][c]==6: g[2][c]=2
    if g[7][c]==6: g[7][c]=2
for c in cols:
    for r in range(2,8):
        if g[r][c]==6: g[r][c]=2
print(cols)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
